title: New isohemigossypol related conjugates and caffeoylated oleanane triterpenoids from Hibiscus syriacus roots with anti-senescence modulating activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21438-21446
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01557C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hyo-Moon Cho, Minh-Thi-Tuyet Le, Ji-Hye Shin, Van-Hieu Mai, Seri Choi, Jin-Pyo An, Yun-Sil Lee, Won-Keun Oh
Six previously undescribed isohemigossypol–phenylpropanoid conjugates and caffeoylated triterpenoids were isolated from Hibiscus syriacus. Compounds 9 and 10 showed strong anti-senescence activity by suppressing p16INK4A and SASP cytokines.
